description: Springer's Lecture Notes in Computer Science class. The host's documents need three class patches. (1) Without its runningheads option llncs sets \ps@empty (llncs.cls l.1237-1238), which defines no marks. Yet its \chapter calls \chaptermark (l.319), which llncs defines only in \ps@headings and \ps@titlepage, both empty (l.1223, l.1233), and prints \@chapapp (l.310, l.333), which neither llncs nor article defines. Every numbered \chapter raised one to three 'Undefined control sequence' errors and set its title once more as body text (llncs.A, batch 3b: 36 documents, 94 branches; \@chapapp in 4, where fncychap did not provide it). Both are provided at \begin{document} as llncs's page styles and report define them (\chaptermark empty, \@chapapp as \chaptername), so a package or page style that defines them first wins. (2) \maketitle writes \@title to the contents (l.953) right after \end{center} has left \par as \@doendpe's macro, still inside \maketitle's group. General's title ends its \parbox with \par, so the write's \edef expanded \par without end (17 of the 20 General-title documents of llncs.A stopped at input stack size; under twocolumn \twocolumn's box keeps that \par, and llncs.B passed 16 of 20). Inside \maketitle the contents writes see the primitive \par; a plain title has none, so nothing it prints changes. The after-hook relies on \maketitle never taking an optional argument, since hyperref's wrapper looks ahead with \@ifnextchar. (3) With hyperref, \maketitle's contents line also makes the title's bookmark, and the \par General's title ends with stopped hyperref's PDF string ("Paragraph ended before \HyPsd@@ProtectSpacesFi was complete" at \maketitle: GitHub run 41584963423, debfaac892710e7979cdf, d9c02be09190814f7b9cd and d4976366b1bd66aad0579 in both llncs.A and llncs.B, one fit branch each, a General title with a way that loads hyperref; e.g. results b9bb7f7da9 and b4c0209098, l.38). So once hyperref loads, PDF strings read \par as a space (\AddToHook{package/hyperref/after}, since the class does not load hyperref itself), as under lipics and tufte-handout; the pages are unchanged. Owner item O-L5 (General's title with no \par) would make the line unnecessary.
